sentences.en: The new law will enfranchise more citizens to vote.
sentences.zh: 新法律将赋予更多公民投票的权利。

sentences.en: Finally, after years of struggle, women were enfranchised in the country.
sentences.zh: 在多年的斗争之后，妇女终于获得了选举权。

sentences.en: The proposal aims to enfranchise young people under 30 with new policies.
sentences.zh: 这项提议旨在通过新政策赋予30岁以下的年轻人政治权利。
